Phil Vetrano, who found tragic daughter Karina’s lifeless body on a Queens running path 10 years ago, has a message for the distraught dad grappling with discovering his own daughter stabbed on a jogging route Friday: Help nail her attacker.

“Do not stop it — make it your life mission” to get justice,’’ Vetrano told The Post on Sunday.

“It’s crazy, it sounds familiar — son of a bitch,” Vetrano, 70, railed of the fiend who left 28-year-old bank teller Katie Suarez brain-dead by stabbing her in the neck as she jogged on a popular Brooklyn waterfront promenade Friday evening.

Vetrano said he can’t believe the eerie similarities between that case and his family’s own tragedy.

As with Suarez’s dad, Vetrano, a retired FDNY firefighter, went searching for his daughter when he grew worried because he hadn’t seen her return from a run on Aug. 2, 2016.

“I was looking for her immediately,” recalled Vetrano, who normally went running with his vivacious daughter, a world traveler who relished life but sat out that day in Spring Creek Park because of back pain.

“I told her, ‘I don’t think it’s a good idea,’” to go alone, Vetrano said. “And she said, ‘Don’t worry, Daddy, I’ll be OK.’ ”

Those were the last words the 30-year-old would ever say to her father.

After little more than a half hour, Vetrano said he had a “bad feeling” and phoned her over and over, to no avail.

The father of Friday’s attacked jogger also phoned his daughter — in this case, because she was late getting to their agreed-upon meet-up spot — and when he got no answer, went looking for her.

The fathers both ended up finding their children.

Karina had been sexually abused and fatally strangled, with her random attacker eventually caught.

Suarez’s attacker is believed to also have been a stranger, but there is no motive yet. She was not robbed or sexually assaulted, according to preliminary findings, law-enforcement sources told The Post on Sunday.

Vetrano said public outrage over Friday’s horror can help fuel the search for Suarez’s killer.

“It has to go viral like Karina went viral,” he said.

He said he stopped his entire life to find Karina’s killer.

“I had a multimillion-dollar business, and I just immediately stopped. I didn’t give a s–t anymore – my mission was to find this guy,” said Vetrano, who recalled blanketing the community with reward posters every day.

To Katie’s dad, he pleaded: “You gotta get public outcry. You have to get people standing up, not forgetting about it, because once it gets swept under the rug, it’s just another little girl that gets killed.”

Vetrano offered to speak with Suarez’s father to offer support.

“People say, ‘Yeah, I understand.’ No, you don’t understand. Only I understand, and he understands. And if he needs somebody to talk to, to help him get through his life, I am willing to speak to him,” Vetrano said.

“In one instant, you don’t believe what you’re seeing — you think, ‘This is not real.’ “

Vetrano said he takes some solace in knowing that Karina lived life to the fullest in her all-too-short 30 years.

“Karina lived her life as if she was dying,” said the dad of the St. John’s University grad with a master’s degree in speech pathology, who worked as a tutor and speech pathologist and was an aspiring writer and actress.

“She did everything she possibly wanted to do.”

بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. فیل وترانو، که 10 سال پیش جسد بی جان دختر غم انگیز کارینا را در مسیر دویدن کوئینز پیدا کرد، پیامی برای پدر پریشان که با کشف چاقو دخترش در مسیر دویدن در روز جمعه دست و پنجه نرم می کند دارد: کمک کنید مهاجم او را میخکوب کنید. "آن را متوقف نکنید - آن را به ماموریت زندگی خود تبدیل کنید" برای به دست آوردن عدالت. وترانو، 70 ساله، از شیطانی که کیتی سوارز عابر بانک 28 ساله را با ضربات چاقو به گردن او در حالی که در گردشگاهی محبوب در کنار آب بروکلین می دوید، مرگ مغزی مغزی به جا گذاشت، وترانو، 70 ساله، مورد انتقاد قرار گرفت. تراژدی همانند پدر سوارز، وترانو، یک آتش نشان بازنشسته FDNY، زمانی که نگران شد، به دنبال دخترش رفت زیرا او را از دویدن در 2 اوت 2016 ندیده بود. وترانو، که معمولاً با دخترش پارکی که در آن روز بهاری سفر کرده بود، به خاطر می آورد که «من فوراً به دنبال او می گشتم». درد وترانو گفت: «به او گفتم فکر نمی‌کنم این ایده خوبی باشد» تا تنها برود. و او گفت: "نگران نباش، بابا، من خوب خواهم شد."
این آخرین کلماتی بود که این زن 30 ساله به پدرش می گفت. پس از نیم ساعت، وترانو گفت که "احساس بدی" دارد و بارها و بارها با او تماس گرفت، بی فایده بود. پدر دونده مورد حمله روز جمعه نیز با دخترش تماس گرفت.

For nearly 30 minutes Sunday afternoon, the Los Angeles Rams looked like a team determined to give away another football game. Fortunately for Sean McVay, the Los Angeles Chargers were more than willing to take that burden off their hands.

In just the second regular-season Battle for LA at SoFi Stadium, the Rams overcame a dreadful first half, forced three turnovers and scored 21 unanswered points to defeat their winless roommates, 24-9, earning consecutive victories for the first time this season.

The Rams (4-4) are back at .500 after a season that appeared to be slipping through their fingers just two weeks ago. Meanwhile, the Chargers (0-7) remain the NFL’s punching bag, with Justin Herbert’s interception problems becoming as inevitable as a dog who barks at the mailman when they see him from the window.

It wasn’t pretty early, but the Rams eventually reminded their crosstown rivals who owns the house.

The afternoon began with an intriguing wrinkle on special teams. The Rams elevated kicker Josh Karty from the practice squad to handle kickoffs alongside veteran Brandon McManus, and the experiment initially looked brilliant.

Karty’s opening kickoff bounced awkwardly in front of the returner, limiting the Chargers to a nine-yard return and pinning them at their own 23-yard line.

Unfortunately, the Rams offense didn’t start as sharp as their new kickoff specialist.

After forcing a three-and-out, Matthew Stafford threw an ugly interception to Tarheeb Still, who jumped a sideline route intended for Konata Mumpfield. A Tyler Higbee false start had turned a manageable third-and-1 into third-and-6, another example of the self-inflicted mistakes that have haunted McVay’s team.

The Chargers couldn’t capitalize, however, and Herbert returned the favor with an interception to Quentin Lake, who nearly took it to the house before being stopped deep in Chargers territory.

Quentin Lake in the right place at the right time 👏LACvsLAR on FOX/FOX OneStream on @NFLPlus pic.twitter.com/6PJJ0x3cpQ

For most of the first half, Stafford and the Rams offense looked completely lost. Five possessions produced zero first downs, while the Chargers built a 9-3 lead behind three field goals.

Then, with halftime approaching, somebody finally flipped the switch.

Stafford connected with Tutu Atwell on a gorgeous 40-yard strike down the left sideline, breathing life into an offense that had been flatlining for nearly two quarters.

Matthew Stafford launches it to Tutu Atwell 🚀LACvsLAR on FOX/FOX OneStream on @NFLPlus pic.twitter.com/ccnqqgtjya

The Rams marched 66 yards in five plays, needing just 1:36 before Kyren Williams punched in a 1-yard touchdown to give Los Angeles a 10-9 lead. A lead they would never relinquish again.

Kyren Williams runs it in for 6️⃣LACvsLAR on FOX/FOX OneStream on @NFLPlus pic.twitter.com/qK8GOsrPpU

Blake Corum emerged from halftime running like a man possessed, carrying five times for 55 yards on the opening possession of the third quarter. His 23-yard touchdown run capped a 74-yard drive and pushed the Rams’ advantage to 17-9.

Blake Corum with the smooth move and TD!LACvsLAR on FOX/FOX OneStream on @NFLPlus pic.twitter.com/YP3lqMMQYg

Suddenly, the Chargers looked overwhelmed.

Even another costly Karty kickoff penalty, his second of the afternoon for a ball bouncing short of the landing zone, couldn’t rescue Herbert and the Chargers offense.

Herbert, who entered Sunday leading the NFL with eight interceptions, threw his second of the afternoon directly to Trent McDuffie, who dropped into zone coverage and made the quarterback pay for never seeing him.

INT 🚨 Trent McDuffie gets the second interception of the day for the Rams!LACvsLAR on FOX/FOX OneStream on @NFLPlus pic.twitter.com/gyGBY0XLhe

Two plays later, Stafford found Puka Nacua on a quick screen. Nacua followed his blockers, broke a tackle and raced 18 yards into the end zone.

The Rams led 24-9, and the Battle for LA was effectively over.

Two weeks ago, the Rams were 2-4, sitting in last place in the NFC West with their Super Bowl aspirations hanging by a thread.

Now they’re 4-4, winners of two straight, and suddenly have a pulse again. They’ll await Monday night’s Bears-Seahawks result to see how the division standings shake out.

For the Chargers, the nightmare continues. At 0-7, their playoff hopes are essentially on life support, and the approaching NFL trade deadline could force some uncomfortable organizational decisions.

Selling veterans for future draft capital might be more sensible than pretending this season can still be saved.

Herbert’s second interception, his NFL-leading 10th of the season, was the final dagger.

McDuffie read the quarterback perfectly, dropping into coverage and intercepting a pass that Herbert never should have thrown.

Two plays later, Stafford connected with Nacua for an 18-yard touchdown, turning an eight-point advantage into a 24-9 lead the Chargers never threatened.

Puka Nacua finds his way to the end zone for a TD 🔥LACvsLAR on FOX/FOX OneStream on @NFLPlus pic.twitter.com/rYQeocKgJN

The Hail Mary that nearly changed everything

The Chargers came within inches of stealing the lead on the final play before halftime.

Herbert’s desperation heave bounced off Johnston and into McConkey’s hands at the goal line, but the Rams stopped him just short.

One more yard could have changed the afternoon entirely.

Instead, the Rams dodged a bullet.

Chargers were SO close 👀LACvsLAR on FOX/FOX OneStream on @NFLPlus pic.twitter.com/VzqR2Cqe4x

The Rams head to the nation’s capital during election week to face the Washington Commanders, looking to extend their winning streak to three games and climb above .500 for the first time this season.

The Chargers return to SoFi Stadium as the designated home team against the Houston Texans, still searching for their first victory.

Winter conditions swept into California over the Halloween weekend, delivering mountain snow, highway closures and rain along the coastal areas.

Chain controls remained in place along Highway 88 as of Sunday afternoon, spanning from east of Ham’s Station to five miles west of Picketts Junction due to accumulating snow and icy corridors, KCRA reported.

Snow showers first began blanketing higher elevations of the Sierra Nevada Saturday morning. The National Weather Service Sacramento had put a Winter Weather Advisory into effect beginning at 8 a.m. Saturday through 7 a.m. Sunday for areas above 7,000 feet.

Several high-altitude Sierra passes faced storm closures by Sunday afternoon. Both Monitor Pass (State Route 89) and Sonora Pass (State Route 108) were fully closed due to snow accumulation, according to the Caltrans QuickMap.

Forecasters projected snow levels to hover between 7,000 and 8,000 feet before dropping to 6,000 to 7,000 feet overnight.

A high-country advisory officially expired at 8 a.m. Sunday, with the agency noting that precipitation was tapering off.

“Chance for additional showers and mountain snow through the morning, with conditions slowly drying out this afternoon. Additional snowfall will be minor through the morning (south of Highway 50), with the potential for a few flurries down to 5500 feet,” NWS Sacramento said in its Sunday morning update.

Slush, ice and reduced visibility have made passes over the Sierra and higher ranges treacherous, with motorists cautioned to carry winter gear and check the Caltrans QuickMap before crossing high elevations.

Further south, an atmospheric river system called a Pineapple Express funneled subtropical moisture across Southern California and the Desert Southwest over the holiday weekend.

The system drove coastal rain and high surf into coastal counties. Most major metropolitan regions in Los Angeles and San Diego recorded lighter precipitation amounts, whereas exposed south- and west-facing mountain slopes received up to three inches of rain, according to NWS San Diego.

A Flood Advisory was issued by the NWS San Diego for coastal Orange County, stretching from Huntington Beach south to San Clemente, in effect until 11 p.m. Saturday due to minor urban flooding concerns.

The short bursts of heavy precipitation added to multi-day storm totals that generally ranged from 0.25 to 0.75 inches across most coastal and inland basins, NWS San Diego posted Sunday afternoon.

Over higher elevations, this moisture plume crossed into sub-freezing air, dropping snowfall across the upper peaks of the Sierra and the Rockies and creating slippery passes for motorists traveling Sunday into Monday.

“What’s fueling this soaking is a southward plunge of the jet stream near the West Coast,” said Weather.com’s senior meteorologist Jonathan Erdman.

“It was a damp end to October,” said NWS Sacramento Sunday morning. “More light rain is possible across interior NorCal Tuesday and Wednesday.”

A secondary Pacific system is tracking toward Northern and Central California ahead of Tuesday, bringing returning cloud cover, lower snow levels and another round of scattered mountain snow and valley showers.

EAST RUTHERFORD, N.J. – The Raiders did not fix everything Sunday.

They did something more immediately useful.

They bought themselves the right to keep trying.

By beating the Jets, snapping a four-game losing streak and getting back to .500, the Raiders reset the conversation around their season. At 4-4, they can legitimately talk about being in the hunt. They can keep playing Kirk Cousins with a purpose beyond postponing Fernando Mendoza’s arrival. They can consider whether the trade deadline presents an opportunity to add help.

For another week, staying the course has some credibility.

That was hardly guaranteed when they walked into the locker room at halftime after allowing the Jets to run for 140 yards.

At that point, the Raiders looked like a team running out of explanations. Getting pushed around had become a weekly occurrence, and now the Jets were taking their turn.

“At halftime, our guys were not happy,” Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said. “We made some adjustments and the guys just played harder.”

Sometimes, the most consequential adjustment is an honest, angry assessment of what is happening.

The Raiders had plenty to be angry about. But they followed that frustration with a response, limiting the Jets to 27 rushing yards after halftime and giving their offense a chance to finish the job.

“We got an interception and we forced them into two punts,” Kubiak said. “I mean, it’s a four-quarter game.”

For a team that had spent a month finding ways to lose, finding its footing before it was too late was the key.

Maxx Crosby described it as taking a stand.

“It really comes down to winning your one-on-ones and outworking the man in front of you,” Crosby said. “And that’s what I felt like we did.”

The difference was noticeable.

“We came out with an attitude in the second half,” Crosby said, “and I feel like we played a lot better collectively.”

Nobody should confuse that response with a permanent solution.

The Jets still finished with 167 rushing yards on 27 carries, an average of 6.2 yards per attempt. That remains an unsustainable way to play defense, particularly with the 49ers and Seahawks looming.

Kubiak did not pretend otherwise.

“It’s a part of our team that we have to address,” he said. “We have to continue to find ways to improve that because it’s hurting us.”

But there is a difference between addressing those problems at 4-4 and explaining them after a fifth consecutive loss.

One keeps the season open. The other would have demanded a much harder conversation about what the Raiders were trying to accomplish.

That conversation can wait.

Cousins earned another week directing an offense that helped deliver a needed victory. The Raiders earned another chance to evaluate their roster through the lens of competing now. Being buyers should remain a consideration if the right opportunity presents itself, although one win hardly justifies abandoning discipline.

The point is they have options.

“It’s been a tough four weeks so we needed that one,” Cousins said, “and we’ll enjoy the flight home now.”

The relief was understandable. So was his appreciation for what the victory preserved.

“It’s great to get a win, to be .500 in November now, and to be playing meaningful football is important,” Cousins said. “It doesn’t get any easier from here, and we understand the challenge ahead.”

Sunday did not erase the preceding month. It did provide evidence that the Raiders could absorb another difficult afternoon, respond together and come out with something to show for it.

Special teams contributed. The offense delivered. The defense finally pushed back.

“We have things that we have to get better at on both sides of the ball,” Kubiak said, “but we’re a team and teams win games.”

For once, that sounded like a description of what happened rather than what needed to happen.

The Raiders still have a ton to clean up.

But they boarded their flight home with a victory, a viable season and a reason to keep moving in the same direction.

For this team, after this month, that qualifies as a reset.

گاهی اوقات، پیامدترین تعدیل، ارزیابی صادقانه و عصبانی از آنچه در حال رخ دادن است است. رایدرها چیزهای زیادی برای عصبانی شدن داشتند. اما آن‌ها این ناامیدی را با پاسخ دنبال کردند و جت‌ها را به 27 یارد راشینگ بعد از نیمه محدود کردند و به حمله‌شان فرصت دادند تا کار را تمام کنند. کوبیاک گفت: "ما یک رهگیری دریافت کردیم و آنها را مجبور کردیم دو پونت بزنند." منظورم این است که این یک بازی چهار ربع است.

Republican gubernatorial candidate Bruce Blakeman is making his final push to try and flip New York with a statewide tour hitting roughly eight cities in the next 48 hours.

Blakeman kicked off the effort Sunday morning on his home turf with a campaign event on Long Island, revealing he plans to make brief visits to Oswego, Albany and Rensselaer County later in the day before heading back to Long Island for the night.

Then Monday, Blakeman plans to swing through Buffalo, Rochester, Syracuse and Binghamton before ending his final pitch in Manhattan — the day before elections.

“We are leaving no stone left unturned,” Blakeman told a small room of supporters, donors and fellow Republican pols at a golf course in Northport.

Blakeman plans to fly to each stop for brief stints to make his final pitch to voters in the cities, many of which lean blue.

The statewide tour comes as Blakeman is currently trailing his political foe and incumbent Gov. Kathy Hochul by double digits, according to multiple major polls.

Registered Democrats have been outnumbering Republicans in early voting around the state and on the GOP stronghold of Long Island as well, according to unofficial election data.

But Republicans are less likely to vote early and tend to cast their ballots on Election Day, according to several studies.

Blakeman said he hopes his sweeping last-ditch effort will get disgruntled New Yorkers who are considering sitting out of the race to vote for him on Election Day.

A recent survey by pollster Convos found that 83% of Long Islanders have their minds made up on who they’re supporting at this point in the race and that nothing will change their vote before Nov. 3, though the poll didn’t measure head-to-head support between Hochul and Blakeman.

But despite what could appear to be an uphill battle, Blakeman remains confident he will flip the state and insists the race for governor is in a “dead heat,” predicting that Republicans will surge with in-person voting on Election Day on Tuesday.

“Forget about the university-woke-polls — I have seen two statewide polls in the last three weeks that have us less than four points behind — that means we’re in the margin of error,” Blakeman said.

“This is a turn-out election,” he added.

The Los Angeles Chargers’ offensive woes have hit a new low during the final play of the first half in Sunday’s Week 8 game against the Los Angeles Rams.

During the final seconds of the second quarter, the Chargers executed a hail mary attempt that was successful and wasn’t.

Chargers were SO close 👀LACvsLAR on FOX/FOX OneStream on @NFLPlus pic.twitter.com/VzqR2Cqe4x

Quarterback Justin Herbert launched a 54-yard pass to the end zone, that ended up being caught by Ladd McConkey in front of a herd of Rams and Chargers players, but falling one yard shy of the endzone, summing up what’s been a season of offensive frustrations for the Chargers.

The knock against the Chargers this season has been their inability to score points, as they entered Sunday as one of the worst scoring offenses in football, scoring an average of 15 points per game.

In the red zone, the Chargers are in a five-way tie with the Seahawks, Vikings, Commanders, and Browns, as they score 50% of the time they’re near the endzone.

The Chargers have yet to score a touchdown against the Rams through the first half, as their 9 points have come off the leg of kicker Cameron Dicker.

The Chargers have spent most of the game leading the Rams, but they gave up a quick go-ahead touchdown to their cross-town rivals when Matthew Stafford executed a two-minute drill, completing four passes in a row for 65 yards, including a 40-yard reception to Tutu Atwell.

The Rams capitalized on the play when Kyren Williams ran into the endzone for a 1-yard touchdown run.

Aside from the brilliant drive, the Chargers defense has kept Stafford uneasy by getting an interception off of him in the first quarter.

Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert hasn’t fared much better than Stafford, finishing the first half completing 14 of 20 passes for 181 yards and having one interception.

The Chargers currently trail the Rams 24-9 through the third quarter.

news.originalContent:
See more of our coverage in your search results.

There is covered. And then there is Brock Bowers covered.

Kirk Cousins is learning those are two entirely different things.

The Raiders quarterback offered an incredible window into the challenge of playing with an extraordinary talent Sunday, placing Bowers in a conversation with some of the best receivers he has thrown to during his career.

Pierre Garçon. DeSean Jackson. Justin Jefferson.

Players whose gifts force a quarterback to reconsider what his eyes are telling him.

Bowers provided two spectacular examples in the Raiders win against the Jets, making an absurd one-handed touchdown catch in traffic, and grabbing another touchdown pass while surrounded by three defenders.

For most pass catchers, those are reasons to look elsewhere.

For Bowers, who finished Sunday with seven catches for 92 yards to go along with the two scores, they are invitations.

The challenge for Cousins, a quarterback whose game is built around accuracy, reading defenses and working through progressions, is accepting the invitation. Everything about his training tells him to find the open receiver.

Bowers requires a different definition of open.

Cousins recalled encountering the same dilemma with Jefferson in Minnesota, where coach Kevin O’Connell sometimes had to remind him that defensive attention did not necessarily eliminate his best option.

“There are times when they would get doubled, and I would progress off of them,” Cousins said.

O’Connell’s message was straightforward: Throw it to Jefferson anyway.

Cousins’ response was equally revealing.

“I don’t like throwing to covered guys,” he remembered replying. “I like throwing to open guys.”

That is a sensible philosophy. It also requires an exception when the target possesses the ability to make a sound defensive play irrelevant.

Bowers is earning that exception.

“The coaching point with Brock has been like it was with Justin,” Cousins said. “When he’s covered, you still need to throw it.”

Simple enough to say. Harder to execute when it means overriding the instincts that have carried Cousins through his career.

“That kind of breaks my instincts,” he said. “My instincts are progressing and throw to open guys.”

Sunday illustrated the reward for making that adjustment. Bowers did not need an unobstructed path to the football. He needed an opportunity to do something remarkable with it.

“There’s moments this year where I can be better,” Cousins said, “and there’s moments where I’m starting to figure that out.”

Bowers keeps giving him reasons to trust it.

Sometimes, three defenders are a warning.

Sometimes, those same three guys are meaningless alongside Bowers.
news.content: پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. پوشش داده شده است. و سپس براک باورز پوشش داده می‌شود. کرک کازنز در حال یادگیری است که این دو چیز کاملاً متفاوت هستند. کوارتربک Raiders پنجره‌ای باورنکردنی را به چالش بازی با استعدادی خارق‌العاده در یکشنبه ارائه داد، و باورز را در گفتگو با برخی از بهترین گیرنده‌هایی که در طول دوران حرفه‌اش به آنها پرتاب کرده بود قرار داد. پیر گارسون. دیشان جکسون جاستین جفرسون بازیکنانی که هدایای آنها یک کوارتربک را وادار می کند تا در مورد آنچه چشمانش به او می گوید تجدید نظر کند. Bowers دو مثال دیدنی را در پیروزی Raiders در برابر جت ها ارائه کرد، یک تاچ داون پوچ با یک دست در ترافیک گرفت و یک پاس تاچ داون دیگر در حالی که توسط سه مدافع احاطه شده بود را گرفت. برای اکثر پاس گیرها، اینها دلایلی هستند که به جای دیگری نگاه کنند. برای Bowers، که یکشنبه را با هفت شکار برای 92 یارد به پایان رساند تا همراه با دو امتیاز، آنها دعوتنامه هستند. چالش برای Cousins، یک کوارتربک که بازیش بر اساس دقت، خواندن دفاع ها و کار کردن از طریق پیشرفت ساخته شده است، پذیرش دعوت است. همه چیز در مورد آموزش او به او می گوید که گیرنده باز را پیدا کند. Bowers به ​​تعریف متفاوتی از open نیاز دارد. کازنز به یاد می آورد که با جفرسون در مینه سوتا با همان معضل مواجه شده بود، جایی که کوین اوکانل مربی گاهی اوقات مجبور می شد به او یادآوری کند که توجه دفاعی لزوماً بهترین گزینه او را حذف نمی کند. کازینز گفت: "زمان هایی وجود دارد که آنها دو برابر می شوند و من از آنها پیشرفت می کنم."

news.originalContent:
Historic turnover in this election will allow dozens of states to vote on significant changes in leadership.

Much of the attention ahead of Tuesday’s midterm elections has fallen on the battle for control of the United States Congress.

But key state-level races are also unfolding, with far-reaching consequences for the country’s future.

This year, 36 US states will vote for their next governor, the most powerful elected official in state government.

An unusually high proportion of those races centre on open seats, with no incumbent governor on the ballot seeking re-election.

In 19 of the races, the current officeholder is either term-limited, like California Democrat Gavin Newsom, or voluntarily opted to not run again, like Iowa Republican Kim Reynolds.

This historic turnover creates the potential for several states to take on significant changes in leadership.

Here’s why these races matter:

Governors serve as the chief executives of their states, overseeing government departments and agencies responsible for delivering public services.

Their powers vary by state. In general, governors propose budgets, appoint senior state officials, direct state agencies about how to enforce existing law, and issue executive orders.

They can also choose to sign into law bills passed by their state’s legislature — or veto them.

One of their most visible areas of influence is reproductive rights. Since the US Supreme Court ruled in 2022 that there is no constitutional right to abortion access, state governments have played a central role in determining whether the procedure is legal.

Each state can now regulate abortion within its boundaries, and some 13 state legislatures have passed complete or near-total abortion bans.

But the Guttmacher Institute, a US-based reproductive rights organisation, noted that about a dozen governors have issued executive orders to “mitigate” the harm done by such bans.

“By issuing executive orders, governors could quickly declare immediate protections for providers and patients,” the organisation said. “This was particularly helpful in states such as North Carolina, where the governor is supportive of abortion rights — but the legislature is not.”

Governors can also influence how US elections are administered.

In some states, governors appoint the officials responsible for overseeing elections, while in others, those officials are elected independently. Governors may also sign or veto legislation changing voting rules, giving them significant influence over election administration.

Governors also help shape how states respond to the federal government.

They may challenge federal policies in court or negotiate with Washington over funding and programme requirements.

State governments also play a major role in implementing federally funded programmes, making cooperation between governors and the White House important.

One example came after former US President Barack Obama’s landmark healthcare policy, the Affordable Care Act, passed the US Congress in 2010.

In the aftermath of its passage, many governors were in a position to decide whether their states adopted the Affordable Care Act’s expansion to Medicaid, an insurance programme for low-income households.

Some governors, like Steve Beshear of Kentucky and Earl Ray Tomblin of West Virginia, issued executive orders in 2013 to adopt Medicaid expansion without their legislatures’ approval.

Others, like Florida’s then-Governor Rick Scott, opposed Medicaid expansion and directed their state legislatures not to adopt it. Scott, who now serves as a US senator for the state, later dropped his opposition, but the Republican-led Florida legislature did not take up a bill to agree to the expansion.

As their state’s chief executives, governors have a unique platform to showcase their political talents.

Many use the governor’s mansion to catapult to the nation’s highest office, the presidency.

At least 17 former US presidents – including Jimmy Carter, Ronald Reagan, Bill Clinton and George W Bush – were governors before they occupied the White House.

But some governors find their presidential ambitions thwarted by backlash to their state-level policies.

The Eagleton Institute of Politics estimates that only 53 percent of the presidential nominees who were previously governors were ultimately victorious in their races.

During the 2016 presidential election cycle, for instance, the governor of New Jersey at the time, Chris Christie, hoped to secure the Republican Party’s nomination.

He dropped out of the race in February of that year, however, amid criticism of several actions undertaken during his governorship.

His administration in New Jersey was still reeling from a scandal known as “Bridgegate”, which concerned accusations that a major roadway was closed to punish the mayor of a nearby city.

And some Republicans denounced the way Christie had greeted Obama, a Democrat, when he visited New Jersey during Hurricane Sandy in October 2012.

This year’s midterm races are expected to set the stage for the presidential election in 2028.

Several outgoing governors are among the likely hopefuls. Newsom, who has served as California’s governor since 2019, is prevented from running for a third term this year.

Instead, he is widely speculated to be a frontrunner for the Democratic nomination in 2028, having established himself as a vocal critic of Republican President Donald Trump.

Several other potential Democratic contenders are also locked in re-election campaigns this midterm cycle that could serve as previews for future presidential bids. They include Wes Moore of Maryland and Josh Shapiro of Pennsylvania.
news.content: چرخش تاریخی در این انتخابات به ده‌ها ایالت اجازه می‌دهد تا در مورد تغییرات مهم در رهبری رأی دهند. بیشتر توجه پیش از انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای روز سه‌شنبه به نبرد برای کنترل کنگره ایالات متحده معطوف شده است. اما رقابت‌های کلیدی در سطح ایالت نیز در حال آشکار شدن است و پیامدهای گسترده‌ای برای آینده کشور خواهد داشت. امسال، ۳۶ ایالت جدید در اکثر ایالت‌های دولتی منتخب، رای خواهند داد. نسبت غیرمعمول بالایی از این رقابت‌ها بر کرسی‌های آزاد متمرکز می‌شوند، بدون اینکه فرماندار فعلی در رای‌گیری به دنبال انتخاب مجدد باشد. در 19 مورد از رقابت‌ها، مقام فعلی یا با مدت محدودی مانند گاوین نیوسام دموکرات کالیفرنیا است، یا داوطلبانه تصمیم گرفت که دوباره نامزد نشود، مانند کیم رینولدز جمهوری‌خواه آیووا. این تغییرات بالقوه تاریخی برای تغییر در ایالت‌های مختلف ایجاد می‌کند. رهبری. در اینجا دلیل اهمیت این مسابقات وجود دارد: فرمانداران به عنوان مدیران اجرایی ایالت های خود خدمت می کنند و بر ادارات و سازمان های دولتی مسئول ارائه خدمات عمومی نظارت می کنند. اختیارات آنها بر اساس ایالت متفاوت است. به طور کلی، فرمانداران بودجه پیشنهاد می‌کنند، مقامات ارشد ایالتی را منصوب می‌کنند، سازمان‌های ایالتی را درباره نحوه اجرای قوانین موجود هدایت می‌کنند و دستورات اجرایی را صادر می‌کنند. آنها همچنین می‌توانند لایحه‌های قانونی تصویب شده توسط مجلس قانونگذاری ایالت خود را امضا کنند - یا آنها را وتو کنند. یکی از بارزترین حوزه های نفوذ آنها حقوق باروری است. از آنجایی که دادگاه عالی ایالات متحده در سال 2022 حکم داد که هیچ حق قانونی برای سقط جنین وجود ندارد

news.originalContent:

The early-season success might’ve masked the reality of where the Lakers are at in their team-building journey.

But they returned to Southern California for their back-to-back set against the Raptors and Heat with a renewed perspective on what needs to happen for them to grow into the championship-caliber team they’re hoping to become.

And how the process isn’t as easy or linear as they made it look early on.

“We want to become a great team,” coach JJ Redick said. “You don’t become a great team in six games. We want to become a great team after 82 games and have a chance to go compete for a championship in April, May and June. It’s a process to get there.”

There was a hitch in the process during Friday’s blowout loss to the Warriors at Chase Center.

The Lakers went from looking like worldbeaters when they took a 25-point lead early in the second quarter to unrecognizable by the time the Warriors completed the 42-point turnaround.

Their offense fell off a cliff when the Warriors blitzed or put two on the ball against Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves.

The Lakers star guards created the types of advantages teams strive for.

But they didn’t cash in on the openings, with it being clear that the role players are still learning how to operate when playing four-on-three basketball.

“We just need to do better with that,” Doncic said. “You create [an] advantage, you put two on the ball. And you got to go score. It’s a four on three, so we gotta be better at that.”

But the small sample the Lakers have when playing against teams deploying more aggressive defensive coverages makes it clear it isn’t as easy as it appears.

There’s a rhythm to playing advantage basketball.

Spacing principles need to be mastered.

Decision-making needs to be quick and crisp before those advantages disappear and evaporate just as quickly as they were created.

With so many new faces, the nuances haven’t set in yet.

“Obviously, it’s a new team, so a lot of guys have different roles,” Walker Kessler said. “It’s different because guys aren’t necessarily comfortable yet, like talking to each other during tough times or calling each other out or taking coaching or taking a response. That just builds with time. We have a lot of talent on this team and a lot of good players. Everyone has seen it. When we’re playing well, playing connected, so continue to build that.”

With the Lakers entering Week 3 of the season, there’s plenty of time for these intricacies to be learned.

“We know we are going to be patient,” Redick said. “There’s also, along with patience, doing what you’re supposed to do. As we play more games together, we do more walk-throughs together, we do more film together, we do more practices together, that we’ll all get better.”
news.content:
پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. موفقیت در اوایل فصل ممکن است واقعیتی را که لیکرز در سفر تیم سازی خود در آن قرار دارد پنهان کرده باشد. اما آنها برای ست پشت سر هم مقابل رپتورز و هیت به کالیفرنیای جنوبی بازگشتند با دیدگاهی تازه در مورد آنچه که باید اتفاق بیفتد تا به تیم قهرمانی تبدیل شوند که امیدوارند تبدیل به آن شوند. و اینکه چگونه این فرآیند به آسانی یا خطی نیست که آنها در ابتدا به نظر می رسیدند. جی جی ردیک مربی گفت: "ما می خواهیم به یک تیم بزرگ تبدیل شویم." "شما در شش بازی تیم بزرگی نمی شوید. ما می خواهیم بعد از 82 بازی به یک تیم بزرگ تبدیل شویم و این شانس را داشته باشیم که در آوریل، می و ژوئن برای قهرمانی رقابت کنیم. رسیدن به آن یک روند است."
در جریان باخت روز جمعه به واریرز در مرکز چیس، مشکلی در این روند وجود داشت. زمانی که لیکرز در اوایل کوارتر دوم با 25 امتیاز برتری داشت، ظاهری شبیه به رقبای جهان داشت تا زمانی که واریرز 42 امتیازی را به پایان رساند، غیرقابل تشخیص بود. زمانی که واریورز در مقابل لوکا دانچیچ و آستین ریوز توپ زدند یا دو توپ را به توپ زدند، حمله آنها از صخره سقوط کرد. اما آنها از افتتاحیه ها پولی دریافت نکردند، زیرا مشخص است که بازیکنان نقش هنوز در حال یادگیری نحوه عملکرد در هنگام بازی بسکتبال چهار بر سه هستند. دانچیچ گفت: "فقط باید با آن بهتر عمل کنیم." "شما یک برتری ایجاد می کنید، دو نفر را روی توپ قرار می دهید. و باید گلزنی کنید. بازی چهار بر سه است.

news.originalContent:
The mission, known as MINURSO, has been in place in the disputed region since a ceasefire in 1991.

United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has warned of potential escalation of hostilities in the disputed Western Sahara region after the expiry of a 35-year-long peacekeeping mission.

“The Secretary-General said he remains concerned about the security situation throughout the territory and the risk of hostilities escalating,” his spokesperson, Stephane Dujarric, said in a statement on Sunday.

Guterres also confirmed the end of the peacekeeping mission on Sunday, after the UN Security Council (UNSC) failed to renew its mandate on Friday.

He urged all concerned “to exercise maximum restraint and to refrain from actions that could further increase tensions or undermine regional stability”.

November 1 marked the start of the “liquidation phase” of the peacekeeping mission, with assets transported back to troop-contributing countries, Guterres said.

The UN established the Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO) in 1991 to monitor a ceasefire and prepare a referendum on the territory’s future.

Morocco has considered Western Sahara its territory since 1975, when Spain withdrew from the desert region in northwest Africa, roughly the size of Britain.

The Polisario Front, an Algeria-backed movement acting on behalf of the Indigenous Sahrawi people, seeks to establish an independent state called the Sahrawi Republic.

At the UNSC on Friday, the US proposed a resolution to support the principle of self-determination in the Western Sahara. Washington’s draft would have extended the mission for a year, removed “referendum” from its name and made Morocco’s autonomy proposal the only basis for further talks.

Russia vetoed the resolution, despite support from 11 of the 15 UNSC members, including fellow permanent members France and the United Kingdom.

The council then defeated a competing Russian resolution, leaving the mission to expire without a new mandate.

“While MINURSO’s peacekeeping operations have concluded, the United Nations stands ready to continue supporting efforts to advance dialogue and pursue a peaceful resolution of the conflict,” Guterres said on Sunday.

Morocco’s royal palace said the fact the mission was not renewed was a “significant development” in withdrawing the Western Sahara issue from the UNSC’s consideration.

On Saturday, Algeria’s Foreign Ministry, however, expressed “deep regret” over the non-renewal, blaming the “excessive bias” of the US towards Morocco’s position.

The Polisario Front said in a statement that it was “concerned at the deadlock in the Security Council meeting”.

Speaking after Friday’s vote, US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz said it was truly unfortunate that in 2026, the veto was used to “preserve the letter R [in the Mission’s name] for referendum”.

He added Washington’s proposal “would have moved the 50-year conflict forward” and that the status quo is unacceptable.

Russia’s UN ambassador, Vassily Nebenzia, said at the same meeting that Moscow opposed the draft because it favoured one side.

“We stress the fact that the Security Council cannot automatically predetermine matters relating to sovereignty,” he said.
news.content: این ماموریت که به عنوان MINURSO شناخته می شود، از زمان آتش بس در سال 1991 در منطقه مورد مناقشه برقرار است. آنتونیو گوترش، دبیر کل سازمان ملل، نسبت به تشدید احتمالی خصومت ها در منطقه مورد مناقشه صحرای غربی پس از پایان ماموریت 35 ساله صلح بان هشدار داد. استفان دوجاریک، سخنگوی وی روز یکشنبه در بیانیه‌ای گفت: «دبیر کل گفت که همچنان نگران وضعیت امنیتی در سرتاسر قلمرو و خطر تشدید خصومت‌ها است.» گوترش همچنین پایان ماموریت صلحبانی را در روز یکشنبه تایید کرد، پس از آن که شورای امنیت سازمان ملل (UNSC) روز جمعه مأموریت خود را تمدید نکرد. او از همه طرف‌های مربوطه خواست «حداکثر خویشتن‌داری را انجام دهند و از اقداماتی که می‌تواند تنش‌ها را بیشتر کند یا ثبات منطقه‌ای را تضعیف کند، خودداری کنند». گوترش گفت که اول نوامبر آغاز «مرحله انحلال» ماموریت حفظ صلح با انتقال دارایی‌ها به کشورهای کمک‌کننده نیرو بود. سازمان ملل در سال 1991 مأموریت همه پرسی را در صحرای غربی (MINURSO) برای نظارت بر آتش بس و آماده سازی همه پرسی در مورد آینده این سرزمین تأسیس کرد. مراکش از سال 1975، زمانی که اسپانیا از منطقه بیابانی در شمال غرب آفریقا، تقریباً به اندازه بریتانیا، از منطقه بیابانی در شمال غربی آفریقا خارج شد، صحرای غربی را قلمرو خود در نظر گرفت. جبهه پولیساریو، یک جنبش تحت حمایت الجزایر که به نمایندگی از مردم بومی صحرای عمل می کند، به دنبال ایجاد یک کشور مستقل به نام جمهوری صحراوی است. در شورای امنیت سازمان ملل در روز جمعه، ایالات متحده پیشنهاد کرد.

news.originalSummary:
یک جت خصوصی با ۹ سرنشین در منطقه پالم بیچ فلوریدا سقوط کرد و تمامی سرنشینان آن کشته شدند.

این سانحه که عصر یکشنبه - ۱۰ آبان - در حدود ۱۲ کیلومتری اقامتگاه تفریحی دونالد ترامپ - مارالاگو - روی داد از سوی مقامات «وحشتناک» توصیف شده است.

هویت سرنشینان این هواپیمای خصوصی که از نوع لیرجت ۶۰ گزارش شده و از مبداء تگزاس به مقصد جزایر باهاما در حرکت بوده، هنوز رسما اعلام نشده است.

تصاویر منتشر شده از محل سقوط این هواپیما، بقایای خاکستر شده آن و گودالی که در پی برخورد آن با زمین پدید آمده را نشان می‌دهد.

اداره آتش‌نشانی و امداد و نجات شهر پالم بیچ در ایالت فلوریدا، وضعیت حادثه را یک «رویداد با شمار زیادی مصدوم» اعلام کرده است.

news.originalContent:
Senator Chris Murphy, a fierce Trump critic who is not up for re-election in the midterms, is ‘alert’ after a stroke.

United States Senator Chris Murphy, a high-ranking Democratic legislator, has suffered a stroke but is “awake and alert”, his senior aide said.

Murphy remained hospitalised on Sunday after seeking medical care for numbness in his arm the day before, his chief-of-staff, Allison Herwitt, said in a statement.

She said he was “responding well to treatment” at John Hopkins, one of the country’s top hospitals.

“The doctors are encouraged by his progress, he is awake and alert, and we are optimistic he will make a full recovery,” Herwitt said.

Murphy is not up for re-election in Tuesday’s midterms that will decide which party controls Congress, but is considered a potential presidential candidate in 2028.

A 20-year senator from the state of Connecticut, Murphy serves as a top Democrat on two powerful Senate committees: appropriations, which decides how US government funds are allocated, and foreign relations.

Murphy toured the Middle East in October, the first regional trip by a US Democrat since the US-Israel war on Iran began in February.

He has been a fierce critic of US President Donald Trump and the Iran war, pledging that Democrats will withhold funding for the war if they win the Senate on Tuesday.

He accused the US Defense Department of denying him access to a US military base in Qatar during his trip last month and has pledged to investigate Trump and his family for alleged corruption if Democrats win the Senate.

Trump said he was “really surprised” to learn about Murphy’s stroke, adding that “nobody wants to have that”.
news.content: سناتور کریس مورفی، یکی از منتقدان سرسخت ترامپ که در انتخابات میاندوره ای حاضر نیست، پس از سکته مغزی "هوشیار" است. سناتور کریس مورفی، یک قانونگذار عالی رتبه دموکرات، دچار سکته مغزی شده است اما "بیدار و هوشیار است"، دستیار ارشد او گفت. مورفی روز یکشنبه برای بی حسی بازو در بیمارستان بستری شد. رئیس ستاد، آلیسون هرویت، در بیانیه ای گفت. او گفت که «به خوبی به درمان» جان هاپکینز، یکی از بیمارستان‌های برتر کشور پاسخ می‌دهد. هرویت گفت: «پزشکان از پیشرفت او دلگرم شده‌اند، او بیدار و هوشیار است و ما خوشبین هستیم که او بهبودی کامل پیدا کند.» مورفی برای انتخاب مجدد در انتخابات میاندوره‌ای روز سه‌شنبه که تصمیم می‌گیرد تصمیم می‌گیرد کدام نامزد بالقوه در کنگره در نظر گرفته شود، نیست. مورفی که یک سناتور 20 ساله از ایالت کنتیکت است، به عنوان یک دموکرات ارشد در دو کمیته قدرتمند سنا خدمت می کند: تخصیص اعتبار، که در مورد نحوه تخصیص بودجه دولت ایالات متحده تصمیم می گیرد و روابط خارجی. مورفی در اکتبر از خاورمیانه بازدید کرد، اولین سفر منطقه ای یک دموکرات آمریکایی از زمان آغاز جنگ آمریکا و اسرائیل علیه ایران در فوریه. او از منتقدان سرسخت دونالد ترامپ، رئیس‌جمهور آمریکا و جنگ ایران بوده است و متعهد شده است که دموکرات‌ها در صورت پیروزی در سنا در روز سه‌شنبه، بودجه جنگ را متوقف خواهند کرد. او وزارت دفاع آمریکا را متهم کرد که در سفر ماه گذشته خود از دسترسی او به پایگاه نظامی آمریکا در قطر جلوگیری کرده است و متعهد شده است که درباره ترامپ تحقیق کند.

news.originalContent:
Moscow and Kyiv continue strikes elsewhere, but no reported violations in Kherson region during the six-day ceasefire.

The longest multi-day truce between Russia and Ukraine, limited to Ukraine’s eastern Kherson region, has come to an end with no violations reported by either side, but also no sign of an extension.

The truce, which ended on Sunday night, allowed hundreds of besieged residents of the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky to be evacuated in a rare joint operation between Kyiv and Moscow.

Russian strikes elsewhere in Ukraine on Sunday left hundreds of thousands of households without power, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said. In Russia, meanwhile, authorities reported major ⁠damage to an industrial site following Ukrainian drone attacks on the Nizhny Novgorod region.

The six-day localised ceasefire in the front-line Oleshky and the surrounding area was reached after mediation efforts by United States First Lady Melania Trump and with the involvement of Pope Leo XIV. It was set to expire at 10:59pm Ukraine time (20:59 GMT).

On Sunday, Ukraine’s military said it evacuated 167 more people from threatened areas of the southern Kherson region, including 22 children and 21 people with limited mobility requiring special assistance.

“Units of civil-military cooperation of the ‘South’ group of forces, in cooperation with representatives of local authorities, evacuated 167 civilians to safer points in the Kherson region,” Ukraine’s General Staff wrote on Telegram.

An estimated 2,000 civilians were in Oleshky when the temporary truce took hold. They were offered the choice to evacuate to Kyiv-controlled territory of Ukraine or territory occupied by Russia, or to remain in the city with replenished food and medical supplies.

“The ceasefire across Oleshky and the surrounding Kherson region has provided residents with the freedom to move, access to food, clean water, medicine, plus a renewed sense of dignity without the constant threat of attack,” Melania Trump said on social media. “Let Oleshky become the starting point for lasting peace.”

Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov, quoted by Russian news agencies, said Moscow had a positive view of how the operation was conducted in Oleshky, as well as of the coordination between the two countries’ human rights commissioners.

A Ukrainian official, however, told the AFP news agency that Russia reportedly refused an offer to extend the ceasefire after Kyiv’s Foreign Ministry proposed it.

Since Russia launched a full-scale invasion of its neighbour in February 2022, Moscow’s forces have occupied most of the eastern Ukrainian regions of Donetsk and Luhansk, as well as the majority of territory in Ukraine’s southern Kherson and Zaporizhia regions.

Kherson Governor Oleksandr Prokudin urged residents to be vigilant as the expiry of the ceasefire neared on Sunday.

“I also strongly urge you not to visit the so-called ‘red zones’ – areas and settlements near the Dnipro [River],” Prokudin wrote on Telegram. “The intensity of Russian strikes there remains high, and the threat to life is extremely high.”

Residents in Kherson city, one of the remaining areas of the region still controlled by Ukraine, remained calm, despite knowing the quiet of the localised ceasefire would soon end.

“Don’t be afraid, keep holding on,” Oleksandr Knyha, head of the Mykola Kulish Kherson Regional Academic Music and Drama Theater, told the audience as he opened a concert.

Knyha is from Oleshky and used to commute from there to Kherson for work. He has not given up hope of returning home.

“That’s also what keeps me here,” he told the Associated Press news agency.

Elsewhere, Moscow and Kyiv have continued air strikes, with Zelenskyy saying on Sunday that Russia continues to target Ukraine’s energy systems before winter. Attacks on power infrastructure in four Ukrainian regions overnight cut electricity to hundreds of thousands of households, he said.

A Russian attack also killed three people, including a 13-year-old girl, in the Ukrainian region of Vinnytsia, when a drone hit the grounds of a vocational school, Ukraine’s State Emergency Service said. Four others were wounded.

Russian drone attacks targeting Ukraine’s Kyiv region for a second consecutive day wounded a woman and damaged homes, energy infrastructure and a retail establishment, regional authorities said.

In its daily report on Sunday, Ukraine’s Air Force said that Moscow’s forces attacked Ukraine with 433 drones overnight, of which 371 were destroyed or suppressed.

Meanwhile, more than 100 Ukrainian drones were shot down over the skies of Russia’s Nizhny Novgorod region east of Moscow, Governor Gleb Nikitin said on Sunday.

The attack sparked a blaze at the Kstovo oil refinery, Russian media outlets reported, sharing images of black plumes of smoke over the horizon.

Zelenskyy said Kyiv also struck a factory for missile components and air defence facilities in Russia’s southern Rostov region.

“We are justly defending ourselves against Russian aggression and doing everything to reduce Russia’s capability to continue it,” Zelenskyy said.
news.content: مسکو و کیف به حملات خود در نقاط دیگر ادامه می‌دهند، اما هیچ نقض گزارشی در منطقه خرسون در طول آتش‌بس شش روزه گزارش نشده است. طولانی‌ترین آتش‌بس چند روزه بین روسیه و اوکراین، محدود به منطقه خرسون شرقی اوکراین، بدون گزارش تخلف از سوی هیچ‌کدام از طرفین به پایان رسیده است، اما هیچ نشانه‌ای از تمدید آن نیز وجود ندارد. آتش بس که یکشنبه شب پایان یافت، به صدها نفر از ساکنان شهر اولشکی اوکراینی تحت اشغال روسیه اجازه داد تا در یک عملیات مشترک نادر بین کیف و مسکو تخلیه شوند. ولودیمیر زلنسکی، رئیس جمهور اوکراین گفت، حملات روسیه در نقاط دیگر اوکراین در روز یکشنبه صدها هزار خانوار را بدون برق گذاشت. در همین حال، در روسیه، مقامات در پی حملات پهپادهای اوکراینی به منطقه نیژنی نووگورود، آسیب‌های عمده‌ای به یک سایت صنعتی گزارش کردند. آتش‌بس محلی شش روزه در خط مقدم اولشکی و اطراف آن پس از تلاش‌های میانجی‌گری ملانیا ترامپ، بانوی اول ایالات متحده و با مشارکت پاپ لئو چهاردهم، حاصل شد. قرار بود در ساعت 10:59 شب به وقت اوکراین (20:59 به وقت گرینویچ) منقضی شود. ارتش اوکراین روز یکشنبه اعلام کرد که 167 نفر دیگر را از مناطق در معرض خطر در منطقه خرسون جنوبی تخلیه کرده است، از جمله 22 کودک و 21 نفر با تحرک محدود که به کمک ویژه نیاز دارند.

دوره دبیرکلی آنتونیو گوترش، دبیرکل سازمان ملل متحد، ۳۱ دسامبر ۲۰۲۶ به پایان می‌رسد و ترکیه نیز به رقابت برای انتخاب جانشین او پیوسته است.

ترکیه که اعلام کرد ۳۱ اکتبر نامزدی خود را ثبت کرده است، روی فریدون سینیرلی‌اوغلو، دبیرکل سازمان امنیت و همکاری اروپا حساب باز کرده است.

روند تعیین نامزدها که از پایان سال ۲۰۲۵ آغاز شده بود، اکنون وارد مراحل پایانی شده است. نامه نامزدی ترکیه در ۳۰ اکتبر، بلافاصله پس از پایان دور هفتم رای‌گیری‌ها، ارائه شد.

در دور هفتم نیز هیچ توافقی بر سر هیچ‌ یک از نامزدها به دست نیامد.

آنکارا بر این باور است که بن‌بست ایجادشده در رقابت، برای نامزدهای جدید فضا باز کرده است.

اما فریدون سینیرلی‌اوغلو کیست و چه شانسی در این رقابت دارد؟

اگرچه دبیرکل سازمان ملل از نظر فنی توسط مجمع عمومی سازمان ملل انتخاب می‌شود، اما مرحله تعیین‌کننده این روند، رای‌گیری‌ها در شورای امنیت سازمان ملل است.

کشورها نامزد معرفی می‌کنند، نامزدها با کشورهای عضو دیدار و گفت‌وگو می‌کنند و سپس پرونده به شورای امنیت ارجاع می‌شود.

اعضای شورا پیش از انتخاب نهایی، مجموعه‌ای از «رای‌گیری‌های آزمایشی» و غیررسمی برگزار می‌کنند.

اعضا برای هر نامزد یکی از سه گزینه «حمایت می‌کنم»، «حمایت نمی‌کنم» یا «نظری ندارم» را انتخاب می‌کنند.

برای انتخاب شدن، یک نامزد باید دست‌کم ۹ رای مثبت در شورای امنیت کسب کند و با وتوی هیچ‌ یک از اعضای دائم شورا مواجه نشود.

به این معنا که موضع پنج عضو دائم دارای حق وتو یعنی آمریکا، روسیه، چین، بریتانیا و فرانسه در این روند نقشی تعیین‌کننده دارد.

پیش از آنکه ترکیه نامه نامزدی خود را ارائه کند، هفت نامزد در رقابت حضور داشتند.

از آنجا که تاکنون هیچ زنی به مقام دبیرکلی سازمان ملل نرسیده است، انتظار می‌رود نامزدهای زن از مزیتی نسبی برخوردار باشند.

او به دلیل تجربه در حوزه توسعه، مبارزه با فقر و امور مالی بین‌المللی، به‌ویژه در میان کشورهای جنوب جهانی، چهره‌ای شناخته‌شده محسوب می‌شود.

گرینسپن در هفتمین رای‌گیری آزمایشی در ۳۰ اکتبر، ۱۱ رای حمایتی به دست آورد، اما پیش‌تر با آرای منفی اعضای دائم شورای امنیت روبه‌رو شده بود. بنابراین، هرچند در جایگاه نخست قرار دارد، اما پیروزی او قطعی نیست.

رافائل گروسی در آغاز رقابت از سوی بسیاری از دیپلمات‌ها از جمله نامزدهای اصلی شناخته می‌شد. او به‌ویژه پس از نقش‌آفرینی دیپلماتیک در پرونده برنامه هسته‌ای ایران و تاسیسات هسته‌ای اوکراین، به چهره‌ای شناخته‌شده در سطح جهانی تبدیل شد.

کارولین رودریگز بیرکت، وزیر خارجه پیشین گویان که سال‌ها به‌عنوان دیپلمات در سازمان ملل فعالیت کرده است، اگرچه به اندازه دیگر نامزدها در افکار عمومی شناخته شده نیست، اما در رای‌گیری‌ها عملکرد خوبی داشته است.

او در آخرین رای‌گیری پس از گرینسپن و یک نامزد دیگر، بالاتر از لانا نسیبه، نامزد امارات متحده عربی، در رتبه سوم قرار گرفت. با این حال او نیز از جمله نامزدهایی بوده که رای منفی اعضای دائم شورای امنیت را دریافت کرده‌اند.

لانا نسیبه، نماینده دائم پیشین امارات در سازمان ملل، به‌دلیل برخورداری از حمایت شورای همکاری خلیج فارس مورد توجه قرار گرفته است. او اگرچه در برخی رای‌گیری‌ها به رتبه‌های بالا رسید، اما نتوانسته در رقابت شتاب بگیرد.

فرآیند نامزدی در نوامبر ۲۰۲۵ آغاز شد و با نزدیک شدن به پایان دوره گوترش، رقابت به مراحل نهایی رسیده است.

ترکیه ابتدا می‌خواست ببیند آیا رقابت به بن‌بست خواهد رسید یا نه.

احمد ییلدیز، نماینده دائم ترکیه در سازمان ملل که درخواست نامزدی را ارائه کرد، گفت ترکیه پس از آن تصمیم به معرفی نامزد گرفت که هیچ اجماعی بر سر نامزدهای موجود شکل نگرفت.

او به خبرگزاری آناتولی گفت ترکیه برای کمک به تسهیل روند کار سازمان ملل، سینیرلی‌اوغلو را نامزد کرده است.

ییلدیز افزود آنکارا به سنت نانوشته‌ای که بر اساس آن انتظار می‌رود دبیرکل بعدی از منطقه آمریکای لاتین و کارائیب انتخاب شود احترام گذاشته و به همین دلیل تا این زمان صبر کرده بود.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

در هفته‌های اخیر برخی تحلیلگران از تبدیل شدن موضوع دبیرکلی سازمان ملل به یک عامل جدید تنش میان ترکیه و جمهوری آذربایجان سخن گفته بودند.

خبرگزاری جمهوری آذربایجان در تحلیلی که ۳۰ اکتبر منتشر کرد، انتقادهایی را متوجه رسانه‌های ترکیه کرد که مدعی بودند باکو از نامزدی لانا زکی نسیبه، نامزد امارات، حمایت می‌کند.

در این تحلیل اشاره شد که ترکیه در آن زمان هنوز نامزد رسمی خود را معرفی نکرده بود و موضع این کشور در قبال امارات در چارچوب نزاکت دیپلماتیک قرار داشت.

با این حال، در همان تحلیل ادعا شد که فریدون سینیرلی‌اوغلو در گذشته از دیپلمات‌هایی بوده که از روند عادی‌سازی روابط با ارمنستان حمایت کرده‌ و به اندازه کافی منافع جمهوری آذربایجان را در نظر نگرفته‌ است و به همین دلیل نیز انتقادهایی متوجه او شد.

بر اساس زندگینامه رسمی، سینیرلی‌اوغلو از دسامبر ۲۰۲۴ به‌عنوان هشتمین دبیرکل سازمان امنیت و همکاری اروپا مشغول به کار بوده است.

او مدرک دکترای خود را در رشته علوم سیاسی و روابط بین‌الملل از دانشگاه بوغازایچی دریافت کرده است.

news.originalTitle: Democrat Haley Stevens heckled as she backs El-Sayed rival
news.title: هیلی استیونز، نماینده دموکرات، در حالی که از رقیب السید حمایت می‌کند، انتقاد کرد
news.originalSummary:
Democrat Haley Stevens heckled as she backs El-Sayed rival

US Democrat Haley Stevens from Michigan was heckled as a ‘traitor’, after endorsing Republican Mike Rogers in the US Senate contest against her party’s candidate Abdul El-Sayed. Stevens lost to El-Sayed in the Democratic primary contest.
news.summary:

news.originalContent:
Canadian PM Carney announces progress in Canada-US trade deal talks ahead of US midterm elections on November 3.

Carney backs EU-Canada associate membership amid Trump tariff threats

Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has announced progress towards a future trade deal with the United States, which could help ease tensions between the two North American neighbours.

The Sunday announcement came just two days before the November 3 US midterm elections, which will determine control of the US Congress.

“Good conversation with US President Donald Trump on the future of Canada-U.S. trade,” Carney posted on X on Sunday.

Ties between Ottawa and Washington have been strained by an escalating trade war, with Canada and the US imposing billions of dollars in tariffs on each other’s goods in recent months.

“Teams from both countries will be working in the coming weeks to deliver that outcome,” Carney said. “This builds on recent constructive discussions on the outlines of a mutually beneficial trade deal.”

In his second term, Trump has upended global trade by imposing tariffs on many of the US’s allies, including Canada – one of the US’s biggest trading partners.

In August, high-level trade talks between Ottawa and Washington broke down, and Trump imposed a 50 percent levy on $20bn of Canadian goods, or 5.5 percent of its exports. Canada responded with equivalent tariffs on US steel, dairy, appliances, farm equipment, pulp and paper, and electronics.

Trump said last week that he expected a new trade agreement with Canada to be reached “pretty soon”, but offered no details.

The trade tensions with Canada have become an issue in the midterm elections, particularly in Michigan and Maine, where Republican candidates have faced pressure over tariffs that have hurt local businesses.

Canada has sought to diversify its trade options and recently welcomed a European Union offer to become an “associate member”.

Carney praised the proposal’s ambition, describing his goal as a “unique alliance” rather than conventional EU membership.

news.originalContent:
President Donald Trump’s low approval ratings, mirroring Americans’ sentiments about the economy, are looming over the 2026 midterms and Republicans’ chances of maintaining control of Congress.

NBC News political analyst Steve Kornacki presented the outlet’s final poll during Sunday’s episode of “Meet The Press.” He noted Trump’s approval ratings have declined going into his second term’s midterm elections, echoing respondents’ dissatisfaction with their personal finances and the economy for the first time in 30 years.

Historically, Trump’s biggest selling point to voters has been his handling of the economy. Ahead of the midterms, however, nearly three quarters of respondents (73%) indicated they were dissatisfied by the effects of the affordability crisis.

“[C]ompare this to Trump’s first midterm in 2018,” Kornacki observed while pointing to a series of poll results displayed on a large screen. “I think this is why his standing in that approval rating is lower now. Because, look at this, in 2018 the economy was his strong suit: nearly 70% of voters on the eve of that midterm were satisfied with it. Total opposite right now. And then there is this one: your own personal financial situation: 49[%] satisfied, 51[%] dissatisfied. This 51% figure that you see right here for ‘dissatisfied,’ that is the first time in over 30 years of the NBC poll that the dissatisfaction number has been at that level, has been a majority.”

Overall, President Trump’s pre-election approval rating sits at 40 percent approval. Despite this low rating, when asked which party would do a better job on key issues, poll respondents still found that the Republican Party would be more favorable in terms of handling the economy, government corruption, and immigration. Respondents also said, however, the Democratic Party would be preferable in addressing the war with Iran and inflation, signaling a shift in satisfaction trends.

“But which party would do a better job on key issues?” Kornacki previewed. “This also tells the story here. When it comes to inflation, Democrats [have] an advantage of a point. That may not seem like much, but this was, like, a 20-point advantage for Republicans just a couple years ago as Trump was returning to the White House. Same thing here on the economy: that is a two-point advantage for [Democrats]. But again, this was Trump’s strong suit, this has historically been a strong suit. For those to even be close, that represents ground gained by Democrats.”

“Is there hope for Republicans?” he comcluded. “The one number they would point to would simply be, and this is a difference from 2018, the image of the two political parties here. Republicans are not popular, but their number, overall as a party, their favorable, unfavorable number [is] about where it was in 2018. The Democrats, though, Kristen, [are] only 29% favorable right now. That’s different than 2018, and that is one of the questions heading into Tuesday. In ‘18, the Democrats, as a party they were positioned to take votes from voters who were dissatisfied with Trump. Does the Democratic Party have more baggage now in a way that will prevent it from capitalizing on all of these other numbers we’re showing you?”
news.content:
محبوبیت پایین دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا، که منعکس کننده احساسات آمریکایی ها در مورد اقتصاد است، در میان دوره ای 2026 و شانس جمهوری خواهان برای حفظ کنترل کنگره ظاهر می شود. استیو کورناکی، تحلیلگر سیاسی NBC News، نظرسنجی نهایی این رسانه را در اپیزود روز یکشنبه "Meet The Press" ارائه کرد. او خاطرنشان کرد که محبوبیت ترامپ در انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای دوره دوم او کاهش یافته است، که برای اولین بار در 30 سال گذشته نارضایتی پاسخ‌دهندگان از امور مالی شخصی و اقتصادشان را منعکس می‌کند. با این حال، پیش از انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای، نزدیک به سه چهارم پاسخ‌دهندگان (۷۳ درصد) نشان دادند که از اثرات بحران استطاعت ناراضی هستند. کورناکی در حالی که به مجموعه‌ای از نتایج نظرسنجی که روی یک صفحه نمایش بزرگ نمایش داده می‌شود، مشاهده کرد: «این را با اولین میان دوره‌ای ترامپ در سال ۲۰۱۸ مقایسه کنید. "من فکر می کنم به همین دلیل است که جایگاه او در آن رتبه محبوب اکنون پایین تر است. زیرا، به این نگاه کنید، در سال 2018 اقتصاد مناسب او بود: نزدیک به 70 درصد از رأی دهندگان در آستانه آن میان دوره ای از آن راضی بودند. کلا برعکس همین الان و سپس این یکی وجود دارد: وضعیت مالی شخصی شما: 49[%] راضی، 51[%] ناراضی. این رقم 51 درصدی که در اینجا برای «ناراضی» می‌بینید، این اولین بار در بیش از 30 سال نظرسنجی NBC است که تعداد نارضایتی در آن سطح بوده است، اکثریت بوده است.

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Ivan Romano/Getty Images)

Europe’s political establishment is facing a growing nationalist backlash over years of permissive immigration policies, with young Europeans taking to the streets to demand tougher borders and an end to mass migration.

From Italy to Spain and France, demonstrations have attracted thousands of participants, ranging from conventional conservatives demanding immigration reform to openly fascist organizations embracing the symbols of Europe’s authoritarian past. While some marchers carry torches and perform Roman salutes, others are ordinary nationalists concerned about their countries’ borders, highlighting the distinction between conservative movements and extremist groups seeking to capitalize on public frustration.

And their concerns about the scale of immigration are backed by official statistics, with asylum applications in the European Union surging from approximately 260,000 in 2010 to more than 1.3 million in 2015, according to the European Council. The influx, driven partly by wars in Syria, Iraq and Afghanistan, coincided with approximately 1.8 million detected irregular border crossings in 2015 alone, according to the European Council.

The migration pressures persisted into the following decade, with first-time asylum applications climbing to approximately 1.05 million in 2023 after declining during the COVID-19 pandemic, according to Eurostat. Although applications declined to approximately 669,400 in 2025, millions of Ukrainians displaced by Russia’s invasion were also living under temporary protection across the bloc, according to the European Council.

The fascist label has also been directed at electoral conservatives, with British Reform UK council leader George Finch alleging he was called a “fascist” before an assault, according to The Guardian.

In Germany, a Guardian opinion column linked opposition to the AfD with combating fascism, although a German court subsequently blocked authorities from designating the entire party as confirmed extremist pending a final ruling, Reuters reported.

(Photo by Ivan Romano/Getty Images)

The nationalist demonstrations take on new significance as widespread unrest grips France and Italy, where rioters looted Milan storefronts, torched vehicles and set the historic city hall in Limoges ablaze during October protests, according to the Associated Press. Some of the “protestors” allegedly crossed the line into terrorism when they decided to openly carry firearms.

In Milan, approximately 2,000 demonstrators marched through the streets on April 29, carrying Italian flags and torches before performing Roman salutes in unison, according to Reuters and ANSA. (RELATED: Europe’s Riots Take Terrifying Turn As Anti-Terror Police Investigate Arson, Reports Of Armed Rioters Surface)

One video uploaded by a far-right account on X shows the Roman Salutes at the finale of the march. The video was corroborated and can be seen from a different angle in an article uploaded by Italian news agency La Stampa.

The nighttime procession commemorated Sergio Ramelli, an 18-year-old activist affiliated with the Italian Social Movement’s youth organization who died in 1975 after being attacked by far-left militants. Participants marched in organized columns toward a memorial on Via Paladini, where they conducted a ceremony honoring fallen comrades, according to ANSA.

Among the demonstrators were activists associated with neo-fascist CasaPound Italia and Lealtà Azione, organizations operating within Italy’s nationalist movement. Participants carried a banner honoring fallen comrades, while the procession’s conclusion featured the synchronized fascist-era salute, ANSA reported.

One image posted by ANSA further corroborates the previous video, showing a different angle of the procession finale, complete with Italian flags and Roman salutes.

Camice nere e saluti romani, la sfilata fascista per Ramelli a Milano https://t.co/bJF1vaD1dD

The demonstration was particularly notable for its scale and its participants’ open use of symbols associated with Benito Mussolini’s fascist dictatorship. Milan Mayor Giuseppe Sala condemned the Roman salutes while acknowledging Ramelli’s place among the victims of Italy’s historical political violence, according to ANSA.

The Milan gathering was not organized as an immigration protest, however, and its size does not establish that Italy’s neo-fascist organizations are attracting more members than in previous years. Rather, it demonstrates that groups explicitly embracing elements of the country’s fascist history retain the organizational capacity to stage substantial public demonstrations.

The connection to contemporary immigration politics became much clearer in Rome on June 13, when thousands of demonstrators marched through the Italian capital demanding the remigration of illegal African and Muslim immigrants back to their countries of origin, according to the Associated Press and La Repubblica.

The demonstration included activists from nationalist organizations such as CasaPound and Veneto Fronte Skinheads, with approximately 4,000 participants reported by La Repubblica. Some shouted slogans praising Mussolini and performed Roman salutes during the march, according to the Associated Press and ANSA.

One video uploaded by Italian news agency Repubblica shows what the event looked like.

Al corteo “Remigrazione e riconquista”, organizzato a Roma dal comitato guidato da Luca Marsella e sostenuto anche da realtà dell’estrema destra come CasaPound, si sono viste decine di tricolori, cori come «non siamo antifascisti» e braccia tese, anche durante l’Inno d’Italia. La manifestazione è stata promossa a sostegno della proposta di legge di iniziativa popolare sulla “remigrazione”. Marsella ha illustrato il programma del movimento, sostenendo la necessità di espellere gli immigrati irregolari e favorire il rimpatrio degli stranieri, «ma non come l’Ice». Video Romina Marceca / Agtw

The march also attracted participants from abroad, including representatives of nationalist networks in Poland, Hungary and Spain. Demonstrators carried Italian flags through Rome’s Prati district while police maintained a significant security presence, according to La Repubblica.

Italy’s electoral conservatives and openly fascist street organizations should not be treated as interchangeable. Opposition to illegal immigration, demands for stronger borders and support for deporting people without legal status do not, by themselves, constitute fascism, whereas the groups participating in these demonstrations have openly displayed fascist-era symbolism.

Spain has witnessed similarly explicit displays, including one demonstration in which teenagers reportedly constituted much of the crowd.

On May 23, 2025, approximately 300 demonstrators affiliated with Falange Española marched through Madrid demanding the removal of immigrants, with the average participant reportedly around 18 years old, according to Research Against Global Authoritarianism and El País.

Many participants wore black clothing, carried Spanish flags and marched in organized rows while promoting remigration. Some delivered fascist salutes and sang the Falangist anthem, according to El País.

The Falange traces its political identity to the movement founded by José Antonio Primo de Rivera, whose ideology became closely associated with Francisco Franco’s dictatorship. The organization’s continued use of historical fascist symbols makes the Madrid procession materially different from conventional conservative demonstrations over immigration policy.

One incident went viral during the protests in Spain, where Spanish women brought shower gel to the event, pointing out how far-left extremists generally tend to smell and have poor hygiene. One video, originally posted by Spanish news agency La Bandera, shows the comedic event unfolding.

Jóvenes manifestantes muestran un bote de gel de baño a los acampados de la Puerta del Sol. https://t.co/o9WwEihnDC

The young participants demanded a harder response to immigration than that offered by mainstream political authorities. Some even directed insults at Madrid’s conservative regional president, Isabel Díaz Ayuso, accusing her of insufficiently restrictive policies concerning unaccompanied migrant minors, El País reported.

The event also attracted counterdemonstrators, prompting authorities to shorten the nationalist march’s planned route and position police between opposing groups, according to El País.

More recently, young demonstrators displaying fascist symbols confronted housing activists in Madrid’s Puerta del Sol following Spain’s National Day military parade on Oct. 12, 2026. Some performed fascist salutes and sang the Falangist anthem while police intervened to separate the competing groups, according to the Spanish Eye and Spanish public broadcaster RTVE.

Another video uploaded by Spanish News agency EuroPress shows the rising tensions at Puerta del Sol.

🔴 Tensión en la Puerta del Sol: asistentes al desfile del 12 de octubre increpan y se enfrentan a los acampados por el derecho a la vivienda https://t.co/Qws0x16LFt https://t.co/t0zj3ARD5F

Three people were arrested and one police officer was injured during the October confrontation, according to RTVE. One photo uploaded by Spanish news agency elDiario.es on X shows the people at the event appear to be mostly teenagers and young adults.

‼️Cánticos de Cara al Sol y saludos fascistas entre un grupo de asistentes al desfile del 12 de octubre que ha tratado de entrar a la acampada de Sol https://t.co/vhIvcSnSJ6

Unlike the earlier Falange demonstration, the October confrontation was not primarily organized around immigration. Nevertheless, both incidents illustrate how explicitly fascist symbols remain visible among sections of Spain’s younger nationalist scene.

France has witnessed its own demonstrations involving young nationalist activists, including a massive gathering following the killing of a 23-year-old activist.

Approximately 3,200 people marched through Lyon on February 21, 2026, commemorating Quentin Deranque, who died after being beaten during a confrontation involving opposing political activists, according to Euronews.

A video uploaded by French news agency BFMTV shows the protesters marching in Lyon.

Mort de Quentin Deranque : selon la préfecture, 3.200 personnes participent à la marche à Lyon https://t.co/WdJ9gF1Tgd

The demonstrations attracted participants from multiple organizations within France’s nationalist movement. French president Emmanuel Macron appealed for calm following Deranque’s killing, according to Euronews.

Another video, also uploaded by BFMTV, shows that some protesters carried torches as they marched.

Mort de Quentin Deranque : des torches ont été brandies en hommage au jeune homme à Lyon https://t.co/ZDi7bL6vvD

Images from the gathering showed activists carrying torches and marching through Lyon, a city with a history of confrontations between far-right and far-left militant organizations. The demonstration attracted nationalist supporters alongside known extremists, including neo-Nazi activists, according to Le Monde.

A third video from BFMTV, clipped from its TV channel, shows a wide shot depicting the large number of protesters.

Mort de Quentin Deranque: retour sur cette journée d’hommage à Lyon https://t.co/mYSU3zqExK

Deranque’s death became a political flashpoint, with opponents of France’s far-left France Unbowed movement raising questions about its relationship with militant activists. The killing involved suspects allegedly connected to the radical left, while the party’s leadership denied responsibility and condemned the violence, according to the Associated Press.

France’s militant nationalist movement has also staged demonstrations invoking older neo-fascist traditions.

On May 10, 2025, activists associated with the Comité du 9 Mai marched through Paris carrying Celtic crosses and other symbols during an annual commemoration. Some participants displayed neo-Nazi insignia and were linked to previously dissolved organizations, according to independent footage published by CLPRESS.

As in Milan, the Paris event centered on a historical commemoration rather than immigration. Its significance lies in the continued coordination of openly neo-fascist organizations, rather than evidence that conservative French voters broadly support their ideology.

Elsewhere in Europe, immigration-related street movements have demonstrated a capacity to mobilize substantially larger crowds; although their participants were not ‘far-right’ or fascists, they were conservatives advocating for the conservation of the United Kingdom.

In London, approximately 150,000 people attended the Sept. 13, 2025, Unite the Kingdom rally organized by anti-immigration activist Tommy Robinson, according to a subsequent attendance estimate released by the Metropolitan Police.

One video uploaded by Reuters shows the protesters marching, arms linked together, with dozens of English and British flags.

Tens of thousands of protesters marched through central London, carrying flags of England and Britain, for a demonstration organized by the anti-immigrant activist Tommy Robinson https://t.co/T8GEzx73KE https://t.co/izDVFt1ZPf

Participants carried British and English flags while voicing concerns about immigration, national identity and government policies. The protest also produced clashes with police, although participation in the broader gathering did not indicate affiliation with “far-right” organizations, Reuters reported.

Similar immigration-related demonstrations occurred in the Netherlands, where hundreds of protesters clashed with police in The Hague in September 2025. Rioters set a police vehicle ablaze and vandalized a political party’s office, while the demonstration’s organizer subsequently disavowed the violence, according to Euronews.

Poland also witnessed widespread anti-immigration demonstrations in July 2025, with protests organized by the right-wing Confederation party in more than 80 cities. Demonstrators demanded stricter border controls and opposed government immigration policies, according to Euronews. (RELATED: Manifest Destiny Is Born Again Among Young Conservatives On Social Media)

In Austria, roughly 200 political activists participated in a July 2025 demonstration advocating remigration, including participants from outside the country. Police also dealt with multiple counterdemonstrations, which resulted in 56 temporary arrests, according to Austrian public broadcaster ORF.

Despite the growing demonstrations, first-time asylum applications in the European Union fell 27% to approximately 669,400 in 2025, with declines recorded in 24 member states, according to the European Commission. Nevertheless, immigration remains a major rallying issue for nationalist movements across Europe.

The demonstrations highlight the divide between conservatives seeking tighter immigration controls and extremist nationalist organizations. From young Falangists in Madrid to torch-bearing militants in Milan, the gatherings also raise questions about whether Europe’s nationalist movements are attracting a new generation of supporters.
